ResearchInfuser publishes practical guides, video tutorials, and learning paths that help scholars, researchers, faculty, and educators streamline their academic workflows.

## Your first steps

1. **Read the Literature Management series.** Begin with [The Literature Management Crisis Every PhD Scholar Faces](2026/01/02/literature-management-crisis/index.qmd) and continue to [Building Your Research Library](2026/01/03/research-library-guide/index.qmd).
2. **Follow the roadmap.** The [Academic Productivity Roadmap](academic-productivity/index.qmd) orders every guide into structured [learning paths](series/index.qmd).
3. **Browse by subject.** Find articles on a specific skill under [Topics](topics/index.qmd).
4. **Watch.** Follow along with the [video tutorials](videos/index.qmd).
5. **Set up your tools.** Explore the [Software Suite](../about/index.qmd#software-suite) used for research and development.
